neighbours.label: capacity nouns: 'ability', 'potential', 'capability', 'power' (the - pole peaks on ' ability' x11, ' potential' x4, ' capability' x2, and ' power' via ' to'); it fires on the noun itself, not on the following 'to'-infinitive (probes: 'ability of/for' fires as much as 'ability to')
fire: The new engine has the ability to run on hydrogen.
Her speech showed the potential of the young party.
The lab lacks the capability to test for that virus.
The mayor has the power to declare a state of emergency.
The telescope has the ability to see distant galaxies.
He demonstrated the potential of the new method.
The army has the capability to deploy within hours.
The board has the power to approve the merger.
quiet: The new engine runs on hydrogen.
Her speech impressed the young party.
The lab cannot test for that virus.
The mayor declared a state of emergency.

notes: Card: ' ability' x11, ' to' x10, ' potential' x4, ' capability' x2 in the top 32. Probes: sentences with ability/potential/capability/power fire 0.35-0.92 peaking on the noun; the same sentences with of/for/over instead of 'to' fire identically (the noun is the trigger); the same topics rephrased without the noun score <= 0.05.
